notes.title: Free DEMO version available!
notes.notes:
We made a big update, in it we had small bug fixes, balancing, new TRAILERS, and the best, a totally free DEMO version! Play now and share it with your friends right now!

notes.title: STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS
notes.notes: It is with great happiness that I announce that the game now has STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS. I am very happy to be able to include this great feature to the game. I hope you like it!! Along with this great update, small new features, small balances, and small bugs were also added. Good game to everyone!
